catalog_scope: Published features extracted from the packaged credit-card documents. Amounts are USD unless noted.

cards.name: Diamond Elite Card

purchase_protection.coverage_cap: Unlimited, subject to policy terms and exclusions

cards.eligibility_text: Membership is invitation-only. A credit score of at least 780 is stated for consideration, but an invitation is not guaranteed.

cards.name: Platinum Rewards Card

purchase_protection.coverage_cap: $17,500 per covered claim, subject to policy terms and exclusions

cards.eligibility_text: The stated minimum credit score for applicants is 750. Typical approved limits range from $25,000 to $150,000; the exact limit appears in approval details.

cards.name: Gold Rewards Card

purchase_protection.coverage_cap: $7,500 per covered claim, subject to policy terms and exclusions

cards.eligibility_text: An active Rho-Bank+ premium subscription and a stated minimum credit score of 720 are required. Typical approved limits range from $17,500 to $112,500.
